name: AI Recommender
description: AI-powered smart playlists and recommendations for Jellyfin (For You, Because You Watched, Hidden Gems, Discover, Wild Card, per-user Letterboxd watchlist). Learns from what you watch.
overview: Builds real similarity-ranked playlists that learn from your watch history. Config-page transparency panel shows exactly why each movie is surfaced or excluded. Self-hosted plugin repository.
